notes: Suite 366 1.30.0, chart 0.10.5. New: a Workflows module that unifies CRM automations, mail rules and processes (triggers, conditions, waits for a reply or a change, AI steps, dry runs); Exchange Server on-premise mailboxes over EWS with Kerberos; personal API tokens with fine-grained rights; one composer for chat and agents on mobile and desktop; content search in Pages spaces and accent- and typo-tolerant CRM search; voice messages up to 15 minutes. Fixes: IMAP mails no longer lost when the server still lists them, desktop sync, iPhone keyboard layout, no more notices to removed members, agent context compaction, approvals given from a chat now run the approved action. Applying restarts the application: a few minutes without Suite 366.
